about_the_game:
Send your heroes into a castle controlled by the demon lord and dungeons filled with creepy statues with the Summerwind Saga - Dark Castle pack! ELV Games is back with another addition to their Summerwind Saga series, this time offering dark brick walls and stone floors that are perfect for evil castles and abandoned fort basements filled with puzzles. This pack’s 8 B sheets have all you need to create a variety of rooms, and with brown and purple versions of each tile you can give different dungeons their own vibe or mark rooms that contain more deadly enemies! Diagonal walls make it easy to build hexagonal rooms and hallways without sharp corners, and thick pillars built into the walls can support the dungeon no matter how many levels down it goes.

This pack also includes character sprites for stone doors and flickering torches. Have your heroes travel between rooms with split stone doors and give the boss room a unique doorway that raises like a gate after defeating all the monsters in the room. Give your players a spooky dungeon to explore with the Summerwind Saga - Dark Castle pack!


Content:

・2 variation of colors
・Ground tiles and wall tiles
・Animated Doors and torches
・Puzzle objects
・Stone Statues, vases, bones
・Spheres, fences
・Treasure Chests
・Lots of props!
